name: Draconic Wild Shape (Mythic)
body:
You transform into a draconic humanoid with your wild shape.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic Wild Shape.

Benefit(s): When you use wild shape to take the form of an animal, you can expend two additional daily uses of your wild shape class feature and 2 points of mythic power to add the half—dragon creature template to your animal form. You can select a different dragon variety every time you use this ability.
